summaries: The ocean suddenly recedes, signaling a massive tsunami approaching the coast. While other residents trap themselves in a traffic jam, the boy runs toward a sturdy seven-story concrete hotel for vertical evacuation, but finds the stairwell locked just as the wave strikes.

The wave crashes through the hotel lobby, trapping the boy in rising water. After failing to open the locked stairwell, he uses a floating vending machine to reach the ceiling air ducts and crawls inside just as the room collapses.
arc.title: Mega Tsunami
